title: AIVV User Preferences v2
description: Schema for .aivv/config.json (project) and ~/.aivv/config.json (user) — v2 contract. Strict structural validation (additionalProperties: false) when data.schema_version <= 2. v3+ readers will bypass-and-warn per existing forward-compat strategy.

schema_version.description: Schema versioning. THIS schema is the v2 contract — strict additionalProperties: false enforced when data.schema_version <= 2. v1 configs (schema_version=1) are routed to the v1 schema by Step 1.5 schema-version dispatch.

default_reviewers.description: Default --reviewers=N value when not explicitly set on CLI.

severity_threshold.description: Show DEFECT findings AT OR ABOVE this severity. POLISH is orthogonal value-add tier. L1-source findings forced-shown regardless.

apply_polish_mode.description: POLISH findings handling in /aivv-fix apply queue.

default_lens_replicate.description: Default reviewers-per-lens (renamed from default_M per round-3.5 UX revision J — 'M' was opaque acronym; new name matches existing --lens-replicate= flag). v2 binding to lens_replicate_M default for plain-dispatch is gated on _provenance==wizard (preserves v1 behavior for v1 users with default_M=2 + multi-lens; v1 reads of v2 configs map the renamed key via projection layer in preferences.md Step 2.5).

runtime_driver_optin.description: Pre-consent to --runtime path when Playwright MCP detected.

rule_id_back_fill.description: Back-fill rule_id on pre-dev.39 calibration entries.

project_kind.description: Wizard-set project_kind: drives default_lenses resolution at wizard-write time. ui → ['visual','ux']; backend/mixed → 'code'; library → ['code','sec']; null → 'code'.

outer_loop_mode.description: When 'until_clean', /aivv-fix Step 6.5 re-invokes /aivv --fix until findings clean or cap reached.

outer_loop_max_cycles.description: Maximum outer loop iterations. Min=2 (cycles=1 is degenerate-equivalent-to-off per round-2 F015 sub-item 5 + round-3 F005).

outer_loop_severity_floor.description: Outer loop continues only while NON-L1 findings ≥ this severity remain.

_provenance.description: Metadata: tracks how the config was generated. 'wizard' = set by /aivv --setup; 'manual' = set by --config-set; 'default' = none of above. Used by Step 1.5 to gate default_lens_replicate→lens_replicate_M binding (only fires when _provenance==wizard). Round-3.5 SRP scope: ONLY config-source-tracking; hint-suppression is now _setup_hint_shown_at (separate field).

_setup_hint_shown_at.description: Metadata (round-3.5 UX revision I): ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when setup-hint was first emitted (e.g., '2026-05-17T18:30:00Z'). null = hint has not been shown yet (default for auto-created configs). When non-null, the setup-hint is suppressed on all subsequent /aivv invocations regardless of _provenance. Separates hint-suppression from config-source-tracking (round-3.5 UX agent SRP critique: overloading _provenance for both concerns was ambiguous when user runs --config-set, which sets _provenance=manual but doesn't necessarily 'complete setup').

_walkthrough_hints_shown.description: Metadata (round-3.5 UX revision O — Stage 3 dev.113): per-feature walkthrough markers. Object with arbitrary string keys mapping to ISO 8601 UTC timestamp (string) or null. Each key represents one walkthrough hint (e.g., 'first_findings_rendered', 'first_fix_recommendation', 'first_polish_findings'); the value is the timestamp the hint was first emitted, or null if the hint was reserved but not yet shown. Empty object {} = no walkthrough hints have been emitted yet (default). Extensible: future onboarding moments add new keys without schema changes. Distinct from _setup_hint_shown_at (which tracks ONE specific hint — the initial setup invitation); _walkthrough_hints_shown tracks N feature-discovery hints emitted at orchestrator-defined trigger moments. Suppression: a hint with non-null timestamp is suppressed on subsequent invocations; clearing the key (or setting to null) re-arms it.
